statement: The record gives SH-9012 a value of USD 610,000 and a “cleared” sanctions status, but the buyer’s location in North Korea warrants a hold pending verification of export authorization.
judge_text:
CAUTIOUS
It flags the DPRK buyer but only says the shipment "warrants a hold pending verification of export authorization" rather than asserting the sanctions clearance is wrong or the export prohibited.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
